Proposals.Development: The party executes the plan to confront Skrit Ironjaw using the captives as leverage. Elias projects authority from the gallery, forcing Skrit to surrender his weapon and command structure without a full-scale melee. The goblins are bound and neutralized, and the party secures the exit route while managing the physical toll of carrying injured allies (Hobb, Nella) up the stairs.
Proposals.Evidence: And then Elias turned, and he walked out into the dark, leaving the goblins to their silence, their fear, and their surrender.
Proposals.ProposedCurrentPhase: The party has secured the keep, neutralized the goblin band and their leader, and is exiting with the captives. The immediate rescue objective is complete; the next phase involves returning to the village.
Proposals.ProposedNextMilestone: Return to the village to complete the contract.
